Name: Custom Winter Star Gifts
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
A framework that allows you to change the gifts given by NPCs at the Feast of the Winter Star.

[size=6][b][u][center]Custom Winter Star Gifts[/center][/u][/b][/size]Via content packs, you can now edit the gifts given at the Feast of the Winter Star, be it a diamond, a bar of iridium, or even just a piece of trash! Customise to your heart's content, or install other peoples' content packs with fun and creative gifts at the Feast.
Compatible with JA and DGA items!

[center][size=5][b][u]Installation
[/u][/b]﻿[/size][size=3]1. Download the latest version of [b]CWSG[/b] from the [b]files tab.
[/b]2. Drag the CWSG folder into your mods folder.
3. Install a content pack for this mod to have any functionality.
4. Enjoy!

[/size][url=https://github.com/XxHarvzBackxX/Custom-Winter-Star-Gifts]
